P1.contract_requirement: Controlled activity_kind ('POI_VISIT' | 'TRANSIT_ONLY') on every itinerary item, with canonical place_id REQUIRED iff activity_kind == 'POI_VISIT' (and fail-closed INVALID_OR_SCHEMA_NONCOMPLIANT_ITEM on missing/unknown activity_kind).
P1.evidence: BenchmarkItineraryItem (01A) enforces controlled activity_kind ('POI_VISIT' | 'TRANSIT_ONLY') and required place_id; planner_benchmark_evaluator.py (01B/01C) enforces TRANSIT_ONLY_NAMED_POI_VIOLATION when a TRANSIT_ONLY item carries a non-null place_name.

P2.contract_requirement: Deterministic catalog membership validation against frozen REC-A-CORE-V2 catalog for all POI_VISIT items.
P2.evidence: evaluate_benchmark_scenario validates every POI_VISIT item's place_id against the 622 REC-A-CORE-V2 POIs in data/curated/gomate_places_freeze_v2.json without place_name inference.

P3.contract_requirement: Destination membership validation by canonical place_id for all POI_VISIT items.
P3.evidence: evaluate_benchmark_scenario verifies that every grounded POI_VISIT item's catalog destination_slug equals scenario.destination_slug and computes destination_correct_poi_rate and scenario_destination_valid.

P4.contract_requirement: Canonical duplicate-place validation by place_id across POI_VISIT items.
P4.evidence: evaluate_benchmark_scenario counts repeated canonical place_id values across POI_VISIT items and enforces duplicate_poi_violation_count == 0 when allow_revisit_place_ids == false.

P5.contract_requirement: HH:MM time parser, start_time < end_time validator, and intra-day interval overlap checker.
P5.evidence: parse_strict_hhmm and evaluate_benchmark_scenario validate 24-hour HH:MM strings (00:00..23:59), enforce start_time < end_time, and detect intra-day overlaps using half-open [start, end) intervals.

P6.contract_requirement: Estimated-budget ceiling checker separate from real-world price-grounding claims.
P6.evidence: evaluate_benchmark_scenario computes estimated_total_cost across all items, checks estimated_total_cost <= scenario.budget (or NOT_APPLICABLE when budget is null, or UNDEFINED_ZERO_BUDGET_DENOMINATOR for overrun fraction when budget == 0), and separately verifies ARITHMETIC_SELF_CONSISTENCY.

P7.contract_requirement: Opening-hours parser with explicit three-state (COMPLIANT / VIOLATION / UNKNOWN) handling where known VIOLATION fails CORE_SCENARIO_PASS and UNKNOWN remains neutral.
P7.evidence: opening_hours_evaluator.py and planner_benchmark_evaluator.py implement conservative three-state OSM opening_hours evaluation, scenario day/date alignment validation, and evidence-conditional final core_scenario_pass.
